review.reviewBody: This is my second Philips Sonicare Toothbrush.  I really enjoy the performance, the durability, and the features.  My dentists noticed right away that my cleanings were better and asked what I have been doing different and I said, I switched to a different toothbrush :)
review.name: Great Philips Sonicare Toothbrush features!

review.reviewBody:
We swapped a manual toothbrush for the Sonicare 4100 for my daughter. It has been such a great fit for her routine. The little buzz that lets her know when to move to a new area of her mouth is so helpful for her to start to learn how long she should work in each area and also keeps track of how long she's been brushing. It takes the guesswork out of brushing and helps her actually cover everywhere instead of camping out in one spot. It's lightweight enough that she can hold and maneuver it easily on her own, which has made her so much more independent about brushing.
Charging is quick and lasts a long time too, so we're never left scrambling when the battery gets low. It comes in blue instead of the usual black or white, so it stands out on the bathroom counter and there's zero confusion about whose brush is whose. Highly recommend this one for kids (and adults!) who are building good brushing habits! 
Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for allowing me to test this out.
review.name: Better Brushing

review.reviewBody:
TLDR: Super clean and actually enjoyable. Major upgrade from my spin brush.

I had an electric spin style brush that I thought was doing a good job, but I am so glad that I was sent the Sonicare as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel. My teeth feel dentist level clean. It might sound weird, but I can't stop feeling my teeth. The toothbrush itself feels premium; lightweight but doesn't feel plastic-y. The head is more slender so it is much easier to get to the back teeth. It has timers on it, but to be honest, I don't feel like I really need them anymore. I am brushing longer without them, because I low key enjoy brushing my teeth. I am not one to be effusive in reviews typically, but the tooth brush is worth the upgrade. My husband is actually ordering one for himself right now.
review.name: Worth the Upgrade

review.reviewBody:
A mighty toothbrush, don't judge a book by its cover.

Your teeth feel absolutely amazing—like you just walked out of a professional cleaning. This toothbrush along with the brush heads delivers that coveted polished, squeaky-clean sensation with zero harshness. It's silky smooth, never abrasive, and leaves your enamel gleaming and totally free from grime and buildup. Seriously, it's that magical moment when your braces come off and you run your tongue across perfectly smooth teeth. That's the vibe every single time. A manual toothbrush will not give you the same result. Vibration toothbrushes are where its at!

You can dial in the speed and power to match your needs, and the vibration technology works through buildup like a dream—softening it up so it practically melts away. The intensity of the settings strikes the perfect balance: gentle enough to protect your gums (no bleeding, no irritation), but powerful enough to crush it in those hard-to-reach spots. Pro tip: nail that 45-degree angle, and you're golden. That's the secret sauce with electric toothbrushes.


Loved the smart timer and quad pacer feature. Taking the time to brush your teeth is important. It's real easy to not dedicated the right amount to brushing your teeth. it does the work for me which is perfect!


It's a solid toothbrush : soft and gentle enough for sensitive teeth and gums, yet tough enough to deliver serious cleaning power, whitening results, and rock-solid plaque prevention. You get the best of both worlds—comfort and performance.

Disclosure: I received this product as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel.

review.reviewBody: My teeth are feeling so amazing after just one month of using it!
I love the different settings on this toothbrush. The deep clean is my favorite.
review.name: The product has great features!

review.reviewBody:
When used with the Sonicare app, you get a complete picture of how well you are brushing. Love the indication of applying too much pressure and the degree of teeth cleanliness.
The handle should have had a flat surface opposite the brush head so that the handle would not easily roll over when set down on the bathroom counter.
review.name: Great Toothbrush

review.reviewBody: The DiamondClean Smart 9300 has truly impressed me with its powerful cleaning performance. Its C3 replacement brush head removes plaque effectively and leaves no residue on my teeth. The adjustable cleaning modes are well designed and easy to use, making daily brushing simple and comfortable. Because I have been diagnosed with periodontal disease, this electric toothbrush has been a real benefit to my oral‑health routine. I highly recommend the DiamondClean Smart 9300 for anyone managing periodontal disease and seeking a deeper, more effective clean.
